description: sflow_1d_wall_dryland_a221 with the semi-implicit step (A 210 11, A 220 3, theta 0.5, B 95): the cell in front of the land in the coupled eta-P system, the dry cell a wall for the means of the face terms, the source term of the predictor and the Laplacian of eta. Without A 221 2 this run does not stay stable (the hydrostatic cell at the land, 5 cells deep, with the A 220 3 term).
covers: sflow_momentum_SI::nh_active, nh_predictor, nh_assemble, nh_solve with A 221 2
